searchText: I am starting to think we shouldn't do any bridges this go around. Just stick to Discord until we inevitably move services in 2022 <@!191378736254287874> Pinging you here since I can't seem to get your attention on Gitter... the EIPs repository is completely broken at the moment. No one has rights to merge without CI passing, and CI is completely stuck for the whole repository. I don't believe anyone other than you has the rights necessary to *fix* the broken CI (it is probably an invalidated oath key for Travis or something). It has been down all week, and EIPs are starting to back up. Oh snap! Let me DM you and fix this. <@!543900561460822016> can you accept my Discord friend request? The CI issue may be related to an edited Travis YML file you edited recently. I'll put you in a room with <@!301186049323958275> and I <@!191378736254287874> Can I join you in that room? Absolutely. Sent friend request. Vundabar! I opened a PR on the EIPs repo to transition the site from Jekyll to Zola: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2890 It would be great if some people could weigh in. I think that removing all the ruby from our CI pipeline will significantly improve our confidence in builds and deployments. The new `toml` front matter format will also be much better to work with in `eipv` and the mergebot.

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content:
I opened a PR on the EIPs repo to transition the site from Jekyll to Zola: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2890
It would be great if some people could weigh in. I think that removing all the ruby from our CI pipeline will significantly improve our confidence in builds and deployments. The new `toml` front matter format will also be much better to work with in `eipv` and the mergebot.
